name: Treadmill
description: The animal runs on a motorized belt, at a fixed or increasing speed, until it can no longer keep up. Measures endurance and exercise capacity.

parameters.label: Lane length
parameters.help: Length of the running lane on the belt, from the front wall to the rear grid.

parameters.label: Accelerating belt
parameters.help: On: the belt speeds up from the start speed to the end speed. Off: the belt runs at the start speed for the whole trial.

parameters.label: Belt start speed
parameters.help: Belt speed when the trial starts.

parameters.label: Belt end speed
parameters.help: Belt speed reached at the end of the acceleration and then kept. Must not be below the start speed.

parameters.label: Acceleration time
parameters.help: Time the belt takes to go from the start speed to the end speed.

parameters.label: Trial cut-off
parameters.help: The trial ends at this time even if the animal is still running.

metrics.label: Latency to exhaustion
metrics.description: Time until the animal met the exhaustion criterion. Longer latencies indicate greater endurance.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when not scored, (EVENT_NOT_OBSERVED) when the full trial was recorded without exhaustion, (INCOMPLETE_RECORDING) otherwise.

metrics.label: Run time
metrics.description: Time the animal ran, up to exhaustion or the trial cut-off.
metrics.definition: Exhaustion time, or max_trial_duration_s when the full trial was recorded without exhaustion.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when the event was not scored; missing (INCOMPLETE_RECORDING) when it was not observed and the recording is shorter than max_trial_duration_s.

metrics.label: Run distance
metrics.description: Distance covered on the belt during the run. Longer distances indicate greater endurance.
metrics.definition: Integral of the belt speed over the run time; the speed rises linearly from start to end over acceleration_duration_s, then stays constant.
metrics.formula: integral of speed(t) dt over [0, run_time_s]
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when the event was not scored; missing (INCOMPLETE_RECORDING) when it was not observed and the recording is shorter than max_trial_duration_s.

metrics.label: Shocks
metrics.description: How many shocks or rear-grid contacts occurred during the run. More shocks suggest lower motivation or fatigue.
metrics.definition: Shocks strictly before the end of the run.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when shocks were not scored; otherwise missing with the reason of run_time_s.
